summary: O-028 is fixed: the pickers' height no longer depends on how many drives are ready. The drive buttons (DrivePanel, which was a WrapPanel) are now one horizontal row in a ScrollViewer whose horizontal scroll bar is always shown, and disabled while every button fits. PickerPanel measured 152.78 px with 3 and with 29 drive buttons, at 880 px wide and at 560 px wide. With the new drive row, 600 px of window height would leave only 0.3 px over the 376 px of list minimums. So the window's default height and MinHeight both go from 600 to 620, which leaves 20 px spare at the 560x620 minimum. A new hook variable, FSA_HOOK_DRIVES=n, adds n drive buttons shaped like the app's own once the real ones are in. B-007 (seven of its eight runs) and B-008 (both runs) add 26, and B-007 also asserts that PickerPanel is the same height in every run. With the old wrapping panel restored, B-008 fails, so the case catches the defect. The report gained additive PickerPanel {actualHeight} and DrivePanel {buttons} keys. The SL-039 doc and the XAML comment now state the guarantee and what it rests on.

files.why: O-028. DrivePanel is a horizontal StackPanel inside DriveScroller (HorizontalScrollBarVisibility=Visible, VerticalScrollBarVisibility=Disabled), no longer a WrapPanel. The comment above the pickers explains why. Window Height and MinHeight are both 620 (were 600). The outer Grid's comment now says the guarantee holds however many drives are ready, gives the measured 396 px left below the pickers at 560x620, and says why 600 is too short.
LoadDrives' button margin changes from (0,0,8,8) to (0,0,8,0): one line of buttons sits directly above the scroll bar.
Additive schema-1 keys window.PickerPanel {actualHeight} and window.DrivePanel {buttons}, documented in the schema comment, so a case can see the pickers' height against the drive count.

New FSA_HOOK_DRIVES=n, accepted for watch, expand and size. SizeToMinimum becomes PrepareWindow(mode, minimum, extraDrives). It sizes the window when asked, holds the report until the app's own drive buttons are in, then adds n buttons copied from the first real one (padding, margin, alignment, same two lines of text). It logs 'drives in ms held added buttons'. Docs updated.

New CheckDrives and CheckPickers helpers; CheckSized now checks the size only. $ExtraDrives = 26 and FSA_HOOK_DRIVES added to $HookVariables. B-007: every hooked run adds 26 drive buttons at both sizes; the default-size Completed run with the list closed keeps only the machine's real drives. Every run records PickerPanel height and button count, and B-007 asserts all heights are equal while the counts differ. B-008 adds 26 drive buttons. Labels say 880x620, and the header says the cases no longer depend on the machine's drives.
The guarantee is corrected and qualified: '560 by 620 and up, at 100% scaling ... however many drives are ready', because the drive buttons are one line that scrolls sideways (O-028).

obligations.how: The drive buttons are now one horizontal row in a ScrollViewer whose scroll bar is always shown, so the pickers' height no longer depends on the drive count. PickerPanel measured 152.78 px with 3 and with 29 buttons, at 880 and at 560 px wide. The drive row made the pickers 9 px taller, which left 0.3 px at 600 px, so the window's default height and MinHeight are now 620. That fits the 376 px of row minimums in 396 px. FSA_HOOK_DRIVES=n feeds in extra drive buttons like the app's own. B-007 and B-008 add 26 and pass; B-007 asserts the pickers' height is equal across all 8 runs. With the old WrapPanel restored as a mutant, B-008 fails: LargestFilesList, TopLevelList, UnreadableExpander and OutcomeTexts are all out of view. docs/design/SL-039-live-results.md now states the guarantee with its conditions: 560 by 620 and up, 100% scaling, any number of drives.

deviations: The window's default height and MinHeight rise from 600 to 620. The finding offered a sideways-scrolling drive row as one fix and a larger minimum as another; this build needed both. The row's scroll bar lane adds 9 px to the pickers. At 560x600 that left 376.26 px against 376 px of row minimums, measured with 29 drive buttons, which is no margin at all. At 620 there are 20 px spare. The default size is 880x620.

The drive row's horizontal scroll bar is always shown (HorizontalScrollBarVisibility=Visible), and disabled while every button fits, rather than Auto. With Auto the pickers would be 17 px taller whenever the buttons overflow, which is exactly the drive-count dependence O-028 removes. A fixed-height ScrollViewer with Auto would need a height written in pixels from the button's font metrics. An always-present bar keeps the height constant with no magic number.
Drive buttons no longer have an 8 px bottom margin, since they are one line directly above the scroll bar. The gap above Choose a folder is unchanged (its Margin top 8).

The report gained additive schema-1 keys window.PickerPanel {actualHeight} and window.DrivePanel {buttons}, per the x:Name convention, so a case can show the pickers' height is independent of the drive count.
follow_ups: All guarantees are measured at 100% display scaling. At other scalings the pickers' height and the list minimums scale together in device-independent pixels, but that has not been measured.

tests.command: pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tests/window/WindowCases.ps1 -Case B-008 (window still 600 px tall, drive row scrolling, 26 drives added)
tests.note: Passed, but TopLevelList was 46.26 px against a 46 px need: 0.26 px spare at 560x600. This is the measurement behind raising the height to 620.

All eight runs at 880x620 and 560x620, seven of them with 26 extra drive buttons (29 in total). Every list is in view with at least 1 full row. PickerPanel was 152.78 px in every run (3 or 29 buttons). TopLevelList 61.1 px; LargestFilesList 56 to 81 px; UnreadableList 41 px.

tests.command: pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tests/window/WindowCases.ps1 -Case B-008 (mutant: DrivePanel back to a WrapPanel; restored and hash-checked)
tests.note: Failed as intended. With 29 drive buttons wrapping at 560 px, LargestFilesList, TopLevelList (46.04 px, clipped), UnreadableExpander, UnreadableList and OutcomeTexts were all out of view. The case catches O-028's defect.
26 passed (C-001 to C-014, O-016, L-001 to L-003, B-001 to B-008), with the exe published from the final source. N-001 to N-004 were not run: they change SMB mappings.
